tools.name: apply_patch
tools.description: Patch one/many files. Input requires *** Begin Patch and *** End Patch.

input.description: Patch content using the *** Begin Patch/End Patch format.

tools.name: dispatch_action
tools.description: Call an exact Tool Search result id or name through OpenClaw. If arguments are not already clear, call tool_describe with the same id for the full description and schema; do not guess omitted fields from compact input hints.

id.description: Tool search result id or tool name.

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Exact single-file replacements. oldText unique/non-overlapping against original. Merge nearby changes; omit large unchanged spans.

oldText.description: Exact original text; unique and non-overlapping in this call.

edits.description: Targeted replacements against original file; no overlap/nesting. Merge nearby changes.

tools.name: exec
tools.description: For continuous monitoring with future alerts, check automations for supported saved watchers. Ordinary background output cannot wake you to report new events. Run shell now; background continuation supported. Completed calls return command output directly. Use process only when exec reports running with a sessionId; output text alone is not a process handle. Long run: automatic completion wake, when enabled, occurs only after exit; otherwise process confirms completion. Output while still running does not automatically start another turn. Background commands can outlive the turn; use process kill when finished with it. Completion and the configured timeout still apply; this is not a saved, restartable automation. Omit host/node to use the session's configured host. No sleep loops for reminders/follow-ups; use automations. TTY CLI/UI/coding agent: pty=true. Quote arguments containing shell metacharacters, including URL query strings with `?` or `&`.

title.description: Every call: short purpose; never claim success. No secrets.

env.description: Literal overrides; no expansion. Omit to inherit.

yieldMs.description: Milliseconds before returning an ordinary-command handle; default 10000.

awaitResults.description: Result required to finish the task; wait for terminal collection. Not for detached servers.

background.description: Start an independent service now; survives request Stop. Use yieldMs for ordinary work. timeoutSeconds applies.

host.description: Omit: named node or configured host (gateway). auto: configured host.

ask.description: Requests stricter approvals under tools.exec.mode and host policy; channel-origin calls cannot override host ask=off.

node.description: Node id/name; implies host=node if host is omitted. Other hosts conflict.

tools.name: ls
tools.description: List directory entries in binary filename order, including dotfiles and links. Names are JSON-quoted; / marks actual directories. Pass the returned after cursor with the same path to continue.

after.description: Filename cursor returned by the previous page.

tools.name: process
tools.description: Control existing exec: list, poll, log, write, send-keys, submit, paste, kill. poll/log: status, output, quiet success, completion without auto-wake, input hints. Others: input/intervention. kill requests termination or returns the retained terminal result for an already-finished session. After a termination request, poll until a terminal result confirms exit and cleanup before saying stopped. A running poll is still pending. remove hides the record and cannot confirm cleanup. Later process results supersede turn-start snapshots. Control sessions by sessionId; a displayed host PID is not a portable sandbox PID. No polling as timer/reminder; scheduled follow-up uses automations. On a requested monitoring stop, also stop any ordinary exec sessions you created for that request; stopping a saved automation does not stop them. Preserve unrelated work.

sessionId.description: Required for every action except list.

keys.description: Key tokens to send for send-keys

hex.description: Hex bytes to send for send-keys

timeout.description: For poll: wait up to this many milliseconds before returning; max 30000 ms, higher values are clamped to 30000

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read text/image file (jpg/png/gif/webp/bmp); images attach to model context. Text caps 2000 lines or 50KB. Continue with offset/limit, or cursor within a long line.

cursor.description: Character position within the start line; 0-based.

optional.description: Missing paths return structured not_found instead of failing.

tools.name: sessions_yield
tools.description: End this turn to await pending child completions, not submit a final result. Return completed work normally. Does not message other sessions; use sessions_send. Omit waitFor when yielding for your own children; their completions resume this session. Set waitFor:"message" only when a subagent has no pending children and waits for its requester to send it a continuation. For background tools, follow their continuation instructions. Collector runs require agents_wait instead.

waitFor.description: Only for a subagent with no pending children of its own that waits for its requester to send it a continuation. Omit when yielding for your own children: their completions resume this session. Does not send or schedule that message or submit a final result.

message.description: Private context for the resumed turn; not sent to the user.

acknowledgment.description: Optional waiting reply in this session; with waitFor, text for an eligible task pause notice. Not an inter-session message.

tools.name: tool_describe
tools.description: Load the full schema and metadata, including complete server instructions, for one tool id or name. Use this when the input is not already clear or when discovery returned instructionsHint.

id.description: Tool search result id or tool name.

tools.name: tool_search
tools.description: Search the effective Tool Search catalog. Pass query for one search or queries for several independent searches in one call; a non-empty query joins a non-empty batch first, with its own limit. Batch results stay grouped in request order. Queries must be in English: matching is lexical against tool names and descriptions, which are written in English, so another language will usually match nothing. Pass an exact result id or name to dispatch_action. Use tool_describe when you need its input schema or when a result includes instructionsHint; call it before dispatch_action to load the complete server instructions.

query.description: Single search query, in English. A non-empty query joins a non-empty batch first. Null or blank is ignored beside a non-empty batch.

limit.description: Maximum number of single-search results. Omitted or null uses the default. With only batch queries, omit this or set it to null; set limits on each batch entry.

query.description: Search query, in English. Describe the capability you need.

limit.description: Maximum results for this query. Defaults to 8 when omitted.

queries.description: Independent searches. Prefer this alone for several searches; a non-empty query beside it runs as the first entry. Their effective limits may total at most 50; an omitted item limit counts as 8. The serialized query strings may use at most 512 UTF-8 bytes in total.

tools.name: view_image
tools.description: Load image(s) into private model context for inspection: path accepts one local image path or permitted URL; paths accepts up to maxImages entries (20 by default). Does not display, attach, or send files to the user. Prompt images are already visible.

path.description: One local image path or permitted URL.

paths.description: Local image paths or permitted URLs; maxImages default 20.
